scope: desktop synthetic frame-by-frame detector diagnostic; not camera or user-alert evidence

protocol.forwardRule: box center in middle image third
protocol.maskOverlapRule: at least one overlapping central hazard-mask pixel; diagnostic only
protocol.temporalRule: presence transition between successive 300 ms frames
